reason: A VS Code integration for DeepSeek Harness centered on agent chat, runtime connectivity, trace and session visibility, approvals, and workspace or file operations.

summaries.zh: 在 VS Code 中提供 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体聊天、运行时连接、Trace 查看、会话管理以及工作区和文件操作集成。
summaries.en: A VS Code integration for DeepSeek Harness that provides agent chat, runtime connectivity, trace viewing, session management, and workspace and file operations.

capabilities: Provides a VS Code chat interface for DeepSeek Harness
Displays traces, session state, runtime activity, approvals, and file changes
Manages providers, API keys, agent presets, workspaces, and sessions
Downloads and connects to a local Harness Runtime
Uses VS Code APIs and local workspace resources
